notes.note: #0.27-0.29 are the last three leader variants of the block begun in story_056 (Zeta, 00, Wing Zero per the 0335 script); identical Japanese to #0.26, so identical English.
#0.33-0.43 leader variants; script order Rider 1, Black RX, Den-O, W, OOO, Zero, Mebius, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero. #0.35 is Momotaros (rough); #0.36-0.43 identical.

#0.2-0.23 are leader pairs set by pt_01_txt2 in the 0336 script: W, OOO, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Zero, Mebius, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero (two rows each). Identical Japanese (#0.2/8/10/14/16; #0.9/11/17/19) given identical English. Dropped subject of 'no time' restored as 'we' (the party).
Momotaros: 'Skull ja nee daro' rendered 'Skull, my ass!!' to keep the force; trailing line break in source dropped.
Zero's slot per script; 'your true identity is Dummy Dopant' rendered 'What you really are is Dummy Dopant'.

#0.28-0.38 are all labelled Wing Zero by the extractor but are leader variants; script order Mebius, Zero, W, OOO, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, Nu, Zeta, 00, Wing Zero. #0.32 is Momotaros, the only one who falls for the hostage act (pays off in #0.45). #0.31/#0.33 differ only by a comma, same English.
Rider 1's slot; idiom for being dumbfounded (mouth hanging open) rendered 'left slack-jawed'.

#0.41-0.51 leader variants (all labelled Wing Zero); script order Mebius, Zero, W, OOO, Den-O, RX, Rider 1, then Nu/Zeta/00/Wing Zero. 'Ultra Warriors' per glossary. #0.45 is Momotaros finally realising it's a fake.
Fake Ultraman is Alien Zarab in disguise (labelled Alien Zarab in #0.62); 'we' for the pair being seen through.
Unlabelled; read as Fake Ultraman (Zarab) blaming Skull/Dummy, who just called him useless in #0.52. His next line #0.55 is labelled Fake Ultraman.
-sama on Terror Dopant rendered 'Lord Terror Dopant' (precedent: 'Lord Ikadevil', 'Lord Weather').
'Uchuujin Rengou' rendered 'Alien Alliance' - not in glossary; recurs in story_070/074-078.
Narration; the two disguised villains revert to Dummy Dopant and Alien Zarab.

report: 80/80 rows. Party-leader variant order taken from the 0335/0336 event scripts; #0.28-0.51 mislabelled Wing Zero by the extractor. 0336 #0.54 unlabelled, read as Fake Ultraman (Zarab). New term: 'Alien Alliance' (uchuujin rengou), not in glossary. 'Lord Terror Dopant' for -sama.
